purpose: Official Qwen-Image-2.1 Prompt Enhancer system prompts, vendored byte-exactly for B-135 (B135-039).
whyVendored: These are the vendor's own system prompts. The answer contract they produce is part of what the fine-tuned PE checkpoints were trained against, so the prompt must travel with the weights. A re-typed or re-wrapped copy is a PARAPHRASE: it reviews as identical and quietly changes what the model emits.

source.commitSubject: Add system prompt files for t2i and edit PE

notInterchangeable: The two tasks have SEPARATE checkpoints and SEPARATE system prompts. There is no merged prompt. Using the stock (non-PE) Qwen3.5-VL 9B with either prompt does NOT reliably emit the answer contract (vendor-stated: expect parse_ok=false on most rows).

samplingDefaults.note: Vendor production settings per task. presence_penalty is LOAD-BEARING and per-task: the vendor states the two values are not interchangeable and a wrong one 'does not fail loudly - it quietly changes the distribution you sample from'. Never default it.
